infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MOTA uses your location to find nearby rides, show drivers and passengers on the map, and track an active ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: While you're online as a MOTA driver, MOTA shares your location so passengers can see you arriving, even when the screen is locked. Sharing stops when you go offline.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: While you're online as a MOTA driver, MOTA shares your location so passengers can see you arriving, even when the screen is locked. Sharing stops when you go offline.

plugins.photosPermission: MOTA uses your photos so you can upload your profile picture and verification documents.
plugins.cameraPermission: MOTA uses the camera so you can photograph your verification documents and profile picture.
